{{Nickname}}
{{Quote|Can someone please frag the node that little punk is posting off, so we can discuss this thing with quiet?''"<br />"''Done.|h8thegam and daddy, disabling the access of wampa1 to the Cularin holonet node|<ref name="academic review">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20041007|text=Academic Review}}</ref>}} 
The handle '''daddy''' was the user ID of an individual who was active on the [[Cularin holonet node]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Follow the sharing on a Cularin holonet node forum of an intercepted communique that several users interpreted as concerning the [[Almas Academy]], the [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] [[wampa1]] posted on the forum several inflammatory posts regarding the intercept. In response to a request by the user [[h8thegam]], daddy claimed to have disabled the [[HoloNet/Legends|holonet]] node via which wampa1 was accessing the forum, to remove the disruptive slicer from the discussion.<ref name="academic review" />
